text:
anya: Heads up — we just flagged 3 DOA A100s from rack eu-west-2-prod-3 (batch 57). Device IDs: SN-A57-2101, SN-A57-2102, SN-A57-2103. Root cause looks like power rail faults after first boot. Need RMA status and shipping ETA.

simon (NexaSupply): Sorry about that, we saw the few failures in batch 57 at our QA. RMA# RMA-98765432 is open. Replacements were picked, but the pallet hit a customs hold at AMS — missing CN23 + invoice mismatch.

anya: Ugh. How long for customs to clear if we push the docs? We need at least 2 GPUs online tomorrow for a canary rollout.

simon (NexaSupply): If you supply the consolidated commercial invoice + CN23 now we can resubmit; typical release 48–72h. Alternative: we can overnight via DHL Express as an air freight expedite — ~24h, additional freight + duties ~ $4,800 per unit.

jeff: Is the expedite covered under warranty or do we absorb freight? Warranty covers replacement hardware but not expedited shipping unless it's a DOA credit term. What's the warranty note?

simon (NexaSupply): Warranty covers unit replacement (cost of goods), not shipping speed. We can absorb partial freight if you take credit for return freight and allow a restocking fee waiver. For fast option we need approval for freight charge.

kerry: What's the total OOB cost we should approve? Ops budget?

ops-lead: Current cluster impact: eu-west-2 capacity down ~12% for CUDA jobs; queue times up ~2x for short jobs. If we miss tomorrow's canary, rollout stalls — estimated business impact ~$2.1k/hr. Recommend expedite for at least 2 units.

anya: I agree — expedite 2 units, standard for last one. We can rebuild from spare for the short term but we need canonical hardware back before Monday.

jeff: Approving up to $10,000 for expedited shipping out of procurement discretionary for this month. Supply charge breakdown please.

simon (NexaSupply): Thanks — estimating: freight + Duties/insurance = $4,800/unit x2 = $9,600. We can waive the $200 return freight for the DOA cores if you RMA-return the defective units within 30 days.

logistics-bot: TO_VENDOR: Please confirm AWB number when booked. Provide tracking and ETA.

simon (NexaSupply): Booked DHL AWB: 123-4567-890. ETA DHL estimate 24h after pickup. I'll attach the corrected CN23 and consolidated invoice link here: https://files.nexasupply.com/docs/RMA-98765432/CN23.pdf

anya: Please also split shipments so one unit goes direct to eu-west-2-zone-c rack eu-west-2-prod-3 and the other to eu-west-2-zone-b (we'll rotate). Last unit regular ground to our FRA returns hub.

simon (NexaSupply): Noted — will split: AWB 123-4567-890 -> eu-west-2-zone-c, AWB 123-4567-891 -> eu-west-2-zone-b, ground AWB 123-4567-892 -> FRA returns hub.

ops-lead: Need serial mapping so we can pre-stage NVMe image and update inventory. Send me the replacement serials and the RMA manifest.

simon (NexaSupply): Replacements SN-R57-3001, SN-R57-3002, SN-R57-3003. Manifest attached to portal. We will label with your rack allocations.

anya: Quick checklist for the on-call: 1) update capacity pool to mark 2 nodes as incoming, 2) add temporary 2-node spike to shift jobs, 3) hold canary until we confirm diff.

ops-lead: Doing 1 and 2 now. ETA for system ready once hardware arrives and we PXE image: ~2 hours per node.

kerry: Finance note: charge GL code OP-INFR-EXP. Jeff confirmed up to $10k. Please submit invoice with line item freight so we can PO-match.

jeff: Confirming approval for $9,600 freight + any documented customs duties <= $500. Anything beyond we need an addendum.

simon (NexaSupply): Understood. We'll absorb anything over $500 as a courtesy up to $1,000, but we'll notify you if it exceeds that.

anya: One more ask — can you quarantine the defective units in FRA returns hub for forensic? We want kernel logs and power traces.

simon (NexaSupply): Yes, we'll hold DOAs and run our debug routine. Please provide an RMA tag on the units when you ship them back.

logistics-bot: ACTIONS: simon to provide final invoice + AWB confirmation; anya to approve cutover plan; ops-lead to prep imaging.

jeff: Approved. anya, ok to proceed with expedite?

anya: Proceed. I'll post final handoff when 1st AWB scanned in.

simon (NexaSupply): AWB 123-4567-890 scanned pickup at 08:42 UTC. Current ETA 24h. CN23 + invoice resubmitted to AMS customs.

ops-lead: Noted. We'll hold the canary in case of regressions. Thanks team.

anya: Follow-up: once DOAs return and vendor confirms debug, open a postmortem if root cause isn't firmware. We want to avoid repeat batch issues.

simon (NexaSupply): Agreed — will supply debug log packets and final RMA closure notes.

logistics-bot: THREAD CLOSED: AWB in transit. Will reopen if customs delays >48h or further approvals needed.
